summary.en: The block that ends one page crosses the cut changing only its rectangle and becomes the first block of the next page; the rest of the outgoing page rolls up under it.
summary.zh: 结束上一页的那个色块跨过剪辑点，只改变自己的矩形，变成下一页的第一个色块；上一页的其余内容在它下面从下往上卷走。

fits: A seam between two plakat pages where the outgoing page ends on a solid block the next page also needs: a command block to a bar, a pick to a node.
notFor: Pages with no solid block; outlined boxes (the block must be filled to read as the same object); seams that change colour meaning.

intent.en: Keep one solid shape across the cut so two pages read as one argument; the colour keeps its meaning (ink the system, accent the person).
intent.zh: 让一个实心形状跨过剪辑点，两页读起来是同一个论证；颜色的含义不变（墨色是系统，强调色是人）。

content.en: The block's rect on each page and its kind (ink or accent); the pages on either side.
content.zh: 色块在两页上的矩形与种类（墨色或强调色）；两侧的页面。

fits.zh: 两页 plakat 之间的接缝：上一页以实心色块结束、下一页也要用到它，如命令块变横条、选项变节点。

notFor.zh: 没有实心色块的页；只有描边的框（要填满才认得出是同一物体）；会改变颜色含义的接缝。

en: The incoming scene must be told (`enterBy: reblock`, `from`) or it draws its own block a second time.
zh: 要告诉下一场（enterBy: reblock、from），否则它会再画一遍自己的色块。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
